absent: Read versus write access permissions and fault behaviour for each listed register are not shown in these fragments.
Reset values, reserved bit handling, and cross register enable sequencing are not shown in these fragments.
Locking, per CPU scope, virtualization intercepts and interrupt handling contracts are not shown in these fragments.
State machine transitions for tracing, sampling, power control and machine check handling are not shown in these fragments.

findings.text: Core capability reporting uses single flag positions for vulnerability and feature presence. Flag for branch history injection immunity sits at bit 20, while extended APIC disable support sits at bit 21. Post barrier return stack immunity sits at bit 24. Gather sampling control presence sits at bit 25 and gather immunity at bit 26. Register file sampling immunity sits at bit 27 and register clearing behaviour at bit 28. Indirect target selection immunity sits high at bit 62 and is noted as synthesized for guests.

Cache flush, boot control, transactional memory and microcode option controls have fixed addresses and enable bits. Flush command lives at 0x10b with data cache writeback control at bit 0. Boot controls live at 0x119 and 0x11e. Transactional control lives at 0x122 with disable at bit 0 and enumeration clearing at bit 1. Microcode option control lives at 0x123 with random sampling disable at bit 0, development mode at bit 1, fill buffer disable at bit 3, gather disable at bit 4 and gather lock at bit 5.

System entry, machine check, uncore, turbo, snoop, meter and branch addresses are fixed. Entry segment, stack and target live at 0x174 then 0x175 then 0x176. Machine check capability, status, control, error control and extended control live at 0x179 and 0x17a and 0x17b and 0x17f and 0x4d0. Offcore responses live at 0x1a6 and 0x1a7. Turbo limits live at 0x1ad through 0x1af. Snoop responses live at 0x1328 and 0x1329. Outer meters live at 0x3e0 through 0x3e3. Branch select and top live at 0x1c8 and 0x1c9. Power control lives at 0x1fc with efficiency bit 19.

Integrity capability register lives at 0x2d9. Array self test presence is indicated at bit 2, periodic self test presence at bit 4, and store assist blocking behaviour at bit 8. A two bit generation field spans bits 9 through 10. Each single bit indicator has both a position constant and a mask constant derived from that position.

Legacy branch record address ranges and info record layout are fixed. Nehalem style sources start at 0x680 with destinations at 0x6c0, while core style sources start at 0x40 with destinations at 0x60. Info records start at 0xdc0. Mispredict, in transaction, abort and cycle valid occupy top bits 63 down to 60. Cycle count occupies the low 16 bits. Branch type is a four bit field starting at bit 56. Four two bit saturating counters start at bit 32, with per counter and combined masks defined.

Architectural branch record control and entry tables have fixed addresses and control fields. Control lives at 0x14ce with enable at bit 0, privilege filter as two bits starting at bit 1, call stack mode as one bit at bit 3, and branch type filter as seven bits starting at bit 16. Depth lives at 0x14cf. Source, destination and info tables start at 0x1500 then 0x1600 then 0x1200 respectively.

Precise sampling and performance capability registers have fixed addresses and decoded fields. Sampling enable lives at 0x3f1, data configuration at 0x3f2, debug store area at 0x600, and capabilities at 0x345. Metric and trace indices are 15 and 16. Load latency threshold lives at 0x3f6. Capability word carries format in low six bits, trap at bit 6, architectural registers at bit 7, record format in bits 8 through 11, firmware writes at bit 13, baseline at bit 14 and timing info at bit 17, with a combined mask over trap, registers, format, baseline and timing.

Architectural sampling base and index live at 0x3f4 and 0x3f5. Record offset uses the low 23 bits and writable index uses a shift of 4. Reload uses all low 32 bits set. Counter control carries allow at bit 35, general at bit 36, fixed at bit 37 and metrics at bit 38, branch inclusion as two bits starting at bit 40, vector state at bit 49, general registers at bit 61, auxiliary state at bit 62 and master enable at bit 63. A combined mask covers general, fixed and metrics counter selection.

Processor trace control lives at 0x570 with single bit enables. Trace enable is bit 0, cycle accurate mode bit 1, supervisor bit 2, user bit 3, power events bit 4, follow up on page walk bit 5, fabric bit 6, address translation bit 7, table output bit 8, mini timestamp bit 9, timestamp bit 10, return compression disable bit 11, page walk bit 12, branch bit 13, event trace bit 31 and no taken not taken bit 55.

Trace control timing and address filters plus status and output pointers are fixed. Timing ranges use four bit fields starting at bits 14 and 19 and 24. Four address range controls use four bit fields starting at bits 32 and 36 and 40 and 44. Status lives at 0x571 with filter, context, trigger, overflow, error and stopped at bits 0 through 5 and byte count as 17 bits starting at bit 32. Eight range endpoints span 0x580 through 0x587. Translation match lives at 0x572, output base at 0x560 and output mask at 0x561.

Fixed range caching, page attribute, debug and identifier registers have fixed addresses. Fixed 64K lives at 0x250, fixed 16K at 0x258 and 0x259, fixed 4K spans eight registers from 0x268 through 0x26f, and default type lives at 0x2ff. Page attribute lives at 0x277 and is built by packing eight memory type bytes from low to high byte order. Debug control lives at 0x1d9, branch source and destination at 0x1db and 0x1dc, interrupt source and destination at 0x1dd and 0x1de. Process identifier lives at 0xd93 with valid at bit 31.

Debug control uses single bit functions and machine check bank zero has consecutive addresses. Branch recording is bit 0, branch single step is bit 1, bus lock detection is bit 2, trace message bit 6, branch trace store bit 7, branch interrupt bit 8, store exclusion for supervisor bit 9 and user bit 10, freeze of branches bit 11, freeze of counters bit 12, freeze in management mode bit 14 and transactional debug bit 15. Frontend sampling lives at 0x3f7. Bank zero control, status, address and misc live consecutively at 0x400 through 0x403.

Idle residency counters have fixed addresses per package and core state. Package C3 lives at 0x3f8 and package C6 at 0x3f9. Atom package C6 and package C7 share address 0x3fa as aliases. Core C3 then C6 then C7 live at 0x3fc and 0x3fd and 0x3fe. Knights core C6 lives at 0x3ff. Package C2 lives at 0x60d, while package C8 then C9 then C10 live at 0x630 and 0x631 and 0x632.
Package idle latency tolerance registers have fixed addresses per C state. C3 lives at 0x60a, then C6 at 0x60b, then C7 at 0x60c, then C8 at 0x633, then C9 at 0x634, and finally C10 at 0x635.

Power, energy and performance feedback registers have fixed addresses per domain. Voltage regulator config lives at 0x601 and power unit at 0x606. Package limit, energy, throttled time and info live at 0x610 and 0x611 and 0x613 and 0x614. Memory domain equivalents live at 0x618 and 0x619 and 0x61b and 0x61c. First plane limit, energy, policy and throttled time span 0x638 through 0x63b. Second plane limit, energy and policy span 0x640 through 0x642. AMD unit, core energy and package energy live at 0xc0010299 through 0xc001029b.

Thermal design, turbo, active residency, demotion, voltage and throttling reason registers are fixed. Nominal plus two levels plus control span 0x648 through 0x64b, activation ratio lives at 0x64c, platform energy at 0x64d and secondary turbo at 0x650. Weighted, any core, any graphics and combined active residency span 0x658 through 0x65b. Core C1 lives at 0x660 and module C6 at 0x664. Demotion policies live at 0x668 and 0x669. Atom ratios, voltages and turbo equivalents span 0x66a through 0x66d. Core, graphics and interconnect limit reasons live at 0x690 and 0x6b0 and 0x6b1.

Control flow protection uses two control registers, eleven control bits and five stack pointers. User control lives at 0x6a0 and supervisor control at 0x6a2. Shadow stack enable is bit 0, supervisor write protection bit 1, branch termination bit 2, legacy compatibility bit 3, no track bit 4, suppress disable bit 5, reserved spans bits 6 through 9, suppress bit 10 and wait for terminator bit 11. Ring zero through ring three pointers span 0x6a4 through 0x6a7 and the interrupt table lives at 0x6a8.

Productive performance and hardware managed performance registers have fixed addresses and feature bits. Productive counter lives at 0x64e and limit reasons at 0x64f. Power management enable lives at 0x770, capabilities at 0x771, package request at 0x772, interrupt control at 0x773, thread request at 0x774 and status at 0x777. Capability feature presence uses bit 7 for base support, then bit 8 for notifications, then bit 9 for activity window, then bit 10 for energy preference, and finally bit 11 for package requests.

Performance capability decoding and request construction use byte fields and named energy hints. Highest, guaranteed, efficient and lowest levels occupy successive bytes zero through three. Requests place minimum in byte zero, maximum in byte one, desired in byte two and energy preference in byte three. Energy hints are most performance at 0x00, balanced performance at 0x80, balanced efficiency at 0xc0 and most efficiency at 0xff. Activity window packs a masked ten bit value starting at bit 32 and package control places one bit at bit 42.

Performance status predicates and machine check bank addressing follow fixed bit tests and strides. Guaranteed change tests bit 0 while excursion to minimum tests bit 2 in status, and interrupt control tests bit 0 for guaranteed change versus bit 1 for excursion. AMD mask base lives at 0xc0010044. Intel bank control, status, address and misc for bank index N are spaced four apart from bank zero, while AMD mask for bank N is spaced one apart from its base.

Corrected error signalling, legacy counters, reload aliases, version six counters and key partitioning use fixed addresses and strides. Second control base lives at 0x280 with per bank stride one. P6 counters live at 0xc1 and 0xc2 with selectors at 0x186 and 0x187. Knights counters live at 0x20 and 0x21 with selectors at 0x28 and 0x29. First general counter lives at 0x4c1. Reload aliases live at 0x14c1 and 0x1309. Version six general base plus three configs span 0x1900 through 0x1903, fixed counter plus two configs use 0x1980 with 0x1982 and 0x1983, per counter stride is four. Key partitioning lives at 0x87.
